observations.behavior: Adds two optional fields to the Mechanism struct.
observations.posthog_connection: These fields could carry relationship metadata between exceptions. If PostHog uses this Rust component for processing chained or grouped exceptions, it would preserve these IDs through ingestion and resolution.

observations.behavior: Changes deserialization of resolved exceptions from Exception to Box<Exception>.
observations.posthog_connection: This change supports ownership semantics required when chaining multiple exceptions into a single issue; without boxing, shared references might not be compatible with recursive structures needed for complex relationships.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that mechanism properties including exception_id and parent_id survive the full event-to-issue transformation pipeline.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against losing chain information during processing, which is critical if PostHog relies on identifying root causes in nested exception groups.

observations.limitations: The chunk does not show where these new fields are populated or consumed end-to-end, nor whether they connect to existing PostHog dashboards or warehouse exports.
